item_3_1_runtime_attribution.correction: Archived M5 measurements show GP fitting at ~11.6-13.6 s of 57-61 s runs (~20-23%). The remaining ~44 s per run was UNINSTRUMENTED at the time. The M6 instrumentation added candidate-generation and feasibility timers; the profiling artifact research_results/m7_m6_review_profiling.json (9 runs, joint mode, current instrumented engine) shows candidate generation ~44 s, GP fit ~13-14 s, acquisition ~0.6 s, objective ~5 ms — i.e. candidate generation (not GP fitting) is the largest single component on the M5 benchmarks, with GP fitting second. The claim 'GP fitting dominates' is RETRACTED; no conclusive per-component attribution beyond the instrumented stages is made.

M7 fixes the boundary for FUTURE runs (disjoint timers); historical records keep the nested convention and must not be summed.

item_3_4_stagnation.mathematical_construction: BlockStagnationLP: analytic LP f = 3a1+b1+3a2+b2, sum <= 3.2, box [0,1.6]^4. From a budget-tight current configuration the ALTERNATING grouping provably cannot improve: any a-block move that keeps feasibility requires reducing the paired b coordinate, which the block-restricted visit cannot do (only a-coordinates vary), while the JOINT optimum f* = 9.6 at (1.6, 0, 1.6, 0) is reachable by a joint move. This is a PROOF about the construction, not an empirical observation.
item_3_4_stagnation.empirical_observation: The measured M6 runs show the alternating grouping performing worst on this benchmark (mean 8.249 vs joint 8.670, pairwise 8.984 over seeds 0-9) — consistent with, but not proof of, the constructed mechanism.

out_of_block_detector.operational_definition: An 'improvement event outside the visited block' is recorded when an incumbent-improving observation differs from the PREVIOUS incumbent in at least one coordinate outside the visited block's active indices (tolerance 1e-9).
limitations: By construction, block candidates vary ONLY the active coordinates and inherit all fixed coordinates from the current configuration; differences outside the visited block therefore arise almost exclusively from the inherited search center. The near-zero event count is largely a TAUTOLOGY of the block mechanism and must NOT be read as evidence that better joint configurations do not exist.
The detector compares consecutive INCUMBENTS only; it does not scan every observation.
The detector says nothing about joint-move quality; the LP construction (proof) is the only statement about the existence of better joint solutions.
